title: 찜질방 카운터에서: 찜질복 받고 어디로 가요?
objective: Check in at a jjimjilbang and use -(으)려면 to ask where to go.
summary: A short jjimjilbang counter conversation with the words you need to check in.
setting: At the front counter of a jjimjilbang (Korean bathhouse and sauna). A customer is checking in and asking a staff member questions.

task.title: Understand and ask questions
task.line: Read the dialogue again, then answer each question using the words and the -(으)려면 pattern from this worksheet.

words.meaning: the loose T-shirt and shorts you wear in a jjimjilbang
words.example: 찜질복이 좀 큰데 작은 걸로 바꿀 수 있어요?
words.exampleMeaning: These sauna clothes are a bit big. Can I swap them for a smaller size?

words.example: 탈의실에서는 휴대폰으로 사진을 찍으면 안 돼요.
words.exampleMeaning: You must not take photos with your phone in the changing room.
I showered and changed into fresh sauna clothes.
Put your shoes in the shoe locker at the entrance.
I bought baked eggs at the snack bar.

words.meaning: What do I need to do if I want to ~? (After a final consonant, use -으려면: 받으려면. After a vowel or ㄹ, use -려면: 가려면.)
words.example: 구운 달걀을 사려면 어떻게 해야 돼요?
words.exampleMeaning: What do I need to do to buy baked eggs?

dialogue.korean: 어서 오세요. 목욕만 하실 거예요, 찜질방도 이용하실 거예요?
dialogue.meaning: Welcome. Will you just use the baths, or the sauna area too?
I'll use the sauna area too.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 찜질복이랑 수건 받으세요. 신발장 열쇠를 주시면 옷장 열쇠를 드릴게요.
dialogue.meaning: Then take these sauna clothes and a towel. If you give me your shoe locker key, I'll give you a clothes locker key.

dialogue.korean: 여기 있어요. 찜질방에 가려면 어디로 가야 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Here you go. Where do I go to get to the sauna area?
Change into the sauna clothes in the changing room, then go up to the 3rd floor.

exercises: True or false? Answer based on the dialogue: ① 손님은 목욕만 할 거예요. ② 손님은 직원에게 신발장 열쇠를 줬어요. ③ 찜질방은 3층에 있어요.
Fill in the blank with the -(으)려면 form of the verb in brackets: ① 식혜를 ____ 매점으로 가세요. (사다) ② 찜질복으로 ____ 탈의실로 가세요. (갈아입다) ③ 편하게 ____ 수면실로 가세요. (자다)
Put the steps in order: ㉠ 탈의실에서 찜질복으로 갈아입어요. ㉡ 신발을 신발장에 넣어요. ㉢ 카운터에서 옷장 열쇠를 받아요.
You want to buy some water. Ask the staff a question with -(으)려면, using these words: 물을 사다 + 어디로 가야 돼요?
answers: ① False ② True ③ True
① 사려면 ② 갈아입으려면 ③ 자려면
